subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: For the first supported WhatsApp sticker action, should OpenClaw accept only sticker-ready WebP media or also convert ordinary static and animated images?
rationale: Current main already provides the Baileys transport primitive, but conversion scope defines new user-visible behavior, encoding dependencies, validation rules, failure handling, and proof requirements that cannot be inferred safely from source alone.

options.title: Validate WebP input
options.body: Expose the typed sticker action for sticker-ready WebP media and return precise validation errors for unsupported bytes, dimensions, or size.

options.title: Convert static images
options.body: Expose the sticker action and convert ordinary static images to compliant WebP while rejecting animated inputs initially.

options.title: Convert all sticker media
options.body: Include static and animated WebP conversion, extension-chunk handling, and metadata behavior in the first implementation.

recommendation.title: Validate WebP input
recommendation.body: Expose the typed sticker action for sticker-ready WebP media and return precise validation errors for unsupported bytes, dimensions, or size.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns both the canonical WhatsApp outbound-media pipeline and the live QA surface needed to evaluate and prove the chosen contract.
